# Model Setup

Let $t$ be the inter-event time between earthquakes. We model each observed
inter-event time as Gamma-distributed with shape $\alpha = 2$ and rate $\theta$:

$$
t_i \mid \theta \sim \text{Gamma}(2, \theta),
\qquad
f(t \mid \theta) = \frac{\theta^{\alpha}}{\Gamma(\alpha)}\, t^{\alpha - 1} e^{-\theta t}.
$$

Substituting $\alpha = 2$:

$$
f(t_i \mid \theta)
= \frac{\theta^{2}}{\Gamma(2)}\, t_i^{\,2-1} e^{-\theta t_i}
= \theta^{2}\, t_i\, e^{-\theta t_i}.
$$

# Likelihood

For $n$ independent inter-event times $t_1, \dots, t_n$:

$$
L(\theta)
= \prod_{i=1}^{n} \theta^{2}\, t_i\, e^{-\theta t_i}
= \theta^{2n} \left( \prod_{i=1}^{n} t_i \right) e^{-\theta \sum t_i}
\;\propto\; \theta^{2n}\, e^{-\theta \sum t_i}.
$$

# Prior

A Gamma prior is placed on the rate $\theta$:

$$
\theta \sim \text{Gamma}(a, b),
\qquad
\pi(\theta) = \frac{b^{a}}{\Gamma(a)}\, \theta^{a-1} e^{-b\theta}
\;\propto\; \theta^{a-1} e^{-b\theta}.
$$

The prior for the project is estimated by method of moments — matching the pre-1950 data's mean inter-event time to the Gamma moment formulas to recover the shape and rate. Specific calculation: see analysis or presentation.

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#| label: prior
#| message: false
#| fig-cap: "Prior distribution for theta derived from pre-1950 inter-event times."

library(ggplot2)

# Prior hyperparameters (reused by the posterior chunk below)
a <- 5
b <- 1120.5

theta_grid <- seq(0, 0.018, length.out = 500)
prior_df <- data.frame(
  theta   = theta_grid,
  density = dgamma(theta_grid, shape = a, rate = b)
)

ggplot(prior_df, aes(theta, density)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = expression(theta), y = expression(f(theta))) +
  theme_gray()
```

# Posterior

Posterior is proportion to prior conjugate to likelihood:

$$
p(\theta \mid t)
\;\propto\; L(\theta)\, \pi(\theta)
\;\propto\; \theta^{2n} e^{-\theta \sum t_i} \cdot \theta^{a-1} e^{-b\theta}
= \theta^{\,a + 2n - 1}\, e^{-(b + \sum t_i)\,\theta}.
$$

This is the kernel of a Gamma distribution:

$$
\theta \mid t \sim \text{Gamma}\!\left(a + 2n,\; b + \sum t_i\right),
\qquad
\mathbb{E}(\theta \mid t) = \frac{a + 2n}{\,b + \sum t_i\,}.
$$

# Q1: Given the last earthquake occurred $x$ days ago, what is the expected additional wait until the next one?

Let $T > x$ denote the day of the next
earthquake. The truncated conditional density is:

$$
f_{T \mid T > x}(t \mid \theta) = \frac{f_T(t \mid \theta)}{P(T > x \mid \theta)},
\qquad t > x,
$$

so the expected residual waiting time is:

$$
\mathbb{E}[\,T - x \mid T > x, \theta\,]
= \frac{\displaystyle\int_x^{\infty} (t - x)\, f_T(t \mid \theta)\, dt}
       {P(T > x \mid \theta)},
\qquad
f_T(t \mid \theta) = \theta^{2} t\, e^{-\theta t}.
$$

## Denominator: Survival Probability

$$
P(T > x \mid \theta)
= \int_x^{\infty} \theta^{2} t\, e^{-\theta t}\, dt
= \Big[-(\theta t + 1)\, e^{-\theta t}\Big]_x^{\infty}
= e^{-\theta x}\,(1 + \theta x),
$$

using integration by parts and $e^{-\theta t} \to 0$ as $t \to \infty$.

## Numerator

Substitute $u = t - x$ (so $t = u + x$):

$$
\int_x^{\infty} (t - x)\, \theta^{2} t\, e^{-\theta t}\, dt
= \theta^{2} e^{-\theta x}
  \left[ \int_0^{\infty} u^{2} e^{-\theta u}\, du
       + x \int_0^{\infty} u\, e^{-\theta u}\, du \right].
$$

Using the Gamma integral $\displaystyle\int_0^{\infty} u^{k} e^{-\theta u}\, du = \frac{k!}{\theta^{\,k+1}}$:

$$
= \theta^{2} e^{-\theta x}
  \left[ \frac{2}{\theta^{3}} + \frac{x}{\theta^{2}} \right]
= e^{-\theta x}\left( \frac{2}{\theta} + x \right).
$$

## Result

$$
\boxed{\;
\mathbb{E}[\,T - x \mid T > x, \theta\,]
= \frac{e^{-\theta x}\left( x + \frac{2}{\theta} \right)}
       {e^{-\theta x}\,(1 + \theta x)}
= \frac{x + \frac{2}{\theta}}{\,1 + \theta x\,}.
\;}
$$

# Q2: What's the probability the next earthquake occurs within $d$ days?

Let $d$ be the number of days from now and $x$ the current day. We want
$P(T \le x + d \mid T \ge x, \theta)$. By the definition of conditional
probability:

$$
P(T \le x + d \mid T \ge x, \theta)
= \frac{P(x < T \le x + d \mid \theta)}{1 - P(T \le x \mid \theta)}
= \frac{P(T \le x+d \mid \theta) - P(T \le x \mid \theta)}{1 - P(T \le x \mid \theta)}.
$$

$\text{Gamma}(2, \theta)$ CDF for $F(t \mid \theta)$:

$$
\boxed{\;
P(T \le x + d \mid T \ge x, \theta)
= \frac{F(x + d \mid \theta) - F(x \mid \theta)}{1 - F(x \mid \theta)}.
\;}
$$
